Helpers for choosing mesh sizes, time steps, and rational approximation orders.

```{r}
tau_from_h_exact <- function(h, alpha_star) {
  return(h^alpha_star * lamW::lambertW0(h^(-alpha_star)))
}


solve_htau <- function(alpha, m, epsilon, tol = 1e-16) {
  
  stopifnot(alpha > 0, alpha < 2)
  stopifnot(m > 0)
  
  C <- exp(-2*pi*sqrt((1 - alpha/2) * m))
  
  f <- function(h) {
    -log(C * h^(alpha - 2)) - C / h^(2 - epsilon)
  }
  
  ## Find a valid bracket automatically
  h.grid <- 10^seq(-16, -0.01, length.out = 500)
  
  vals <- f(h.grid)
  ind <- which(diff(sign(vals)) != 0)
  
  if(length(ind) == 0)
    stop("No root found.")
  
  h <- uniroot(
    f,
    lower = h.grid[ind[1]],
    upper = h.grid[ind[1] + 1],
    tol = tol
  )$root
  
  tau <- C * h^(alpha - 2)
  
  ## residuals of both equations
  err1 <- abs(tau - h^(alpha - epsilon) * abs(log(tau)))
  err2 <- abs(tau - C * h^(alpha - 2))
  
  list(
    h = h,
    tau = tau,
    error1 = err1,
    error2 = err2
  )
}

solve_htaunew <- function(alpha, m, epsilon, tol = 1e-16) {

  stopifnot(alpha > 0, alpha < 2)
  stopifnot(m > 0)

  C <- exp(-2*pi*sqrt((1 - alpha/2) * m))

  f <- function(h) {
    -log(C * h^(alpha - 2)) -
        3 * C^(1/3) / h^((2*alpha + 2)/3 - epsilon)
    }

  ## Find a valid bracket automatically
  h.grid <- 10^seq(-16, -0.01, length.out = 500)

  vals <- f(h.grid)
  ind <- which(diff(sign(vals)) != 0)

  if(length(ind) == 0)
    stop("No root found.")

  h <- uniroot(
    f,
    lower = h.grid[ind[1]],
    upper = h.grid[ind[1] + 1],
    tol = tol
  )$root

  tau <- (C * h^(alpha - 2))^(1/3)

  ## residuals
  err1 <- abs(tau - h^(alpha - epsilon) * abs(log(tau)))
  err2 <- abs(tau^3 - C * h^(alpha - 2))

  list(
    h = h,
    tau = tau,
    error1 = err1,
    error2 = err2
  )
}

tau_from_h <- function(h, alpha, C) {
  Cmin <- 1  - alpha * log(h)
  if (any(C < Cmin)) stop("No real solution exists because C < 1 + log(2) - alpha*log(h).")
  x <- -1 * exp(-C) / h^alpha
  return(-(h^alpha / 1) * lamW::lambertW0(x))
}

m_from_h <- function(h, alpha, C, tau) {
  arg <- h^2 * ((C - abs(log(tau))) / 2)
  if (arg <= 0) stop("The logarithm argument must be positive.")
  return(ceiling(log(arg)^2 / (4 * pi^2 * (1 - alpha / 2))))
}
```
